c1-14-001.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | The manager and two of her assistants ___ coming to the meeting. (be) |

item.q: The manager and two of her assistants ___ coming to the meeting. (be)
item.why: With *and*, the subject is plural: *The manager and two of her assistants are coming.* With *together with*, it stays singular: *The manager, together with two of her assistants, is coming.*
item.why_lv: Ar *and* teikuma priekšmets ir daudzskaitlī: *The manager and two of her assistants are coming.* Ar *together with* tas paliek vienskaitlī: *The manager, together with two of her assistants, is coming.*

c1-14-002.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | text | Start with *So loud*: The music was so loud that we couldn't hear each other. |

accepted: So loud was the music that we couldn't hear each other.
So loud was the music that we could not hear each other.

item.q: Start with *So loud*: The music was so loud that we couldn't hear each other.
item.why: *So* + adjective at the start, then *be* before the subject: *So loud was the music that…*
item.why_lv: *So* + īpašības vārds sākumā, tad *be* pirms teikuma priekšmeta: *So loud was the music that*…
answers: So loud was the music that we couldn't hear each other.
So loud was the music that we could not hear each other.

c1-14-003.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | text | Join the two sentences with an *-ing* form: The river burst its banks. It flooded the streets near the station. |

accepted: The river burst its banks, flooding the streets near the station.

item.q: Join the two sentences with an *-ing* form: The river burst its banks. It flooded the streets near the station.
item.why: An *-ing* clause after the main clause for its direct result: *…, flooding the streets near the station.*
item.why_lv: *-ing* daļa aiz galvenā teikuma tiešam rezultātam: …, *flooding the streets near the station*.
answers: The river burst its banks, flooding the streets near the station.

c1-14-004.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | text | Start with *Having* and join the two sentences: We checked the train times. We left for the station. |

accepted: Having checked the train times, we left for the station.

item.q: Start with *Having* and join the two sentences: We checked the train times. We left for the station.
item.why: *Having* + past participle when the first action was complete before the second: *Having checked the train times, we left…*
item.why_lv: *Having* + 3. forma, ja pirmā darbība bija pabeigta pirms otrās: *Having checked the train times, we left*…
answers: Having checked the train times, we left for the station.

c1-14-005.gate_key: adv_past | C1 | gap | I'm always losing receipts. I wish I ___ them more carefully. (keep) |

item.q: I'm always losing receipts. I wish I ___ them more carefully. (keep)
item.why: A wish about a present habit: *I wish* + past simple, *I wish I kept them more carefully*. About one moment in the past: *I wish I had kept the receipt*.
item.why_lv: Vēlēšanās par ieradumu tagad: *I wish* + Past Simple, *I wish I kept them more carefully.* Par vienu brīdi pagātnē: *I wish I had kept the receipt.*

c1-14-006.gate_key: adv_perfect | C1 | gap | I ___ the bank all morning, but nobody's answering. (ring) |

item.q: I ___ the bank all morning, but nobody's answering. (ring)
item.why: An activity that has gone on up to now (*all morning*): present perfect continuous, *I've been ringing*. A number of times: *I've rung four times*.
item.why_lv: Darbība, kas turpinās līdz šim brīdim (*all morning*): Present Perfect Continuous, *I've been ringing.* Reižu skaits: *I've rung four times.*

c1-14-007.gate_key: adv_prep | C1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: She took a part-time job ___ her own business. | with a view to starting

item.q: Choose the correct option: She took a part-time job ___ her own business.
item.why: The fixed phrase is *with a view to* + *-ing* (*to* here is a preposition): *with a view to starting her own business*.
item.why_lv: Nemainīgais izteiciens ir *with a view to + -ing* (*to* te ir prievārds): *with a view to starting her own business*.

c1-14-008.gate_key: adv_present | C1 | mcq | Your friend lent you money and is worried. Choose the most natural way to make a promise: ___ I'll pay you back on Friday. | I promise

item.q: Your friend lent you money and is worried. Choose the most natural way to make a promise: ___ I'll pay you back on Friday.
item.why: When saying the words is the act itself, use the present simple: *I promise I'll pay you back.*
item.why_lv: Ja paši vārdi ir darbība, lieto Present Simple: *I promise I'll pay you back.*
